Senior Business Development Specialist Company: CCRIF SPC Employment Type: Full-time Workplace Type: Remote (with travel as required ) Contract: 3-year contract, renewable Location: Caribbean (remote) The Senior Business Development Specialist (Sr. BDS) is a full-time strategic leadership position within CCRIF SPC supporting the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) in driving portfolio growth, designing revenue diversification frameworks, and managing high-level sovereign relationships to maximise portfolio value and market expansion. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Sr. BDS owns the end-to-end business development cycle, from market identification and technical stakeholder briefings to structural alignment and final agreement execution, and partners with the Chief Risk Management Officer on the structuring of quotes. The role involves direct, peer-level engagement with ministers, senior government officials, heads of sub-national agencies, utility executives, and regional development partners. The Sr. BDS reports directly to the CEO. Key Responsibilities Leads high-level advisory for the CEO on communicating benefits to sovereign clients. Drives strategic outcomes during policy renewal roadshows and stakeholder sessions. Own the end-to-end business development cycle—from market identification and technical stakeholder briefings to structural alignment and final agreement execution. Contributes strategically to strategic marketing, communication, and regional capacity-building initiatives. Directs how market intelligence and trend analysis shape product innovation pipelines. Drives robust business-to-business and government relations to protect portfolio value. Working with the CRMO, provides input to country risk profile strategies to scale up coverage over time. Partners with the Chief Risk Management Officer to structurally design quotes. Identifies new market segments and commercialization opportunities for parametric insurance lines. Leads the execution of business development and revenue diversification strategies. Build, maintain, and deepen institutional relationships with senior government officials, ministers, heads of sub-national agencies, utility executives, and regional development partners. Qualifications & Experience Master’s degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Development Finance, Disaster Risk Management, Reinsurance, Insurance, Actuarial Science, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of ten (10) years of post-graduate, progressive professional experience in development finance, disaster risk management, reinsurance, or international insurance markets. Desired Skills Proven track record of conceptualizing and executing high-level market development strategies or innovative financial product structuring. Demonstrated ability to influence senior decision-makers, negotiate complex multi-stakeholder agreements, and represent an organization at regional forums. Deep familiarity with the socio-economic landscape of the Caribbean  and Central America. Must be based in the Caribbean or in close geographical proximity (e.g., Miami, Central America) to facilitate immediate and frequent travel across member states.
